header: beside the paragraph that explains it
bodytext:
The figure keeps its full display size. The text column beside it explains what a caption cannot: what was counted, against what, and where the claim stops being true.

A switch swaps the two halves. In the source order the figure always comes first, so screen reader users hear the claim before the explanation.
note: The source line sits under a rule below the text. Put the method and the date of measurement in it.
